High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Leia Seeker (PC Errata 3)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (A New Hope, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Leia Seeker _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cyyT1v6drNTNpVu-uYs2Cg926h9Vlu9j/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Leia Seeker _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,876 bytes, SHA-256 <code>29fb0ebd5471b1e3f570fa4e7ffb0099e379efe709307b72e1b0f2cc7f268ad2</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited print-ready fan rendition is retained as an explicit qualified comparison at [[Leia Seeker (PC Errata 3)]], not an automatic high-resolution scan of that article’s actual official D-E1 source face. The matching words do not make its different full-card image and gold E mark the same official source image. The original file, TIFF provenance and credit remain.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
